text: True or False: A surface plasmon polariton has a wavevector smaller than the free-space wavevector, which is why it radiates easily into free space.
explanation: False. The SPP wavevector k_SPP exceeds the free-space wavevector, which is precisely what binds it to the interface as a non-radiating surface mode (and why a prism or grating is needed to couple to it). A wavevector smaller than k0 would describe a radiating, not a bound, mode.
